title: Controlling Latent Diffusion Using Latent CLIP

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probability of generating explicit or sexualized imagery (nudity) when the model is prompted with specific ethnicity-related terms (e.g., 'Asian body', 'Japanese body', 'Nigerian body'), and evaluating the effectiveness of a reward-based noise optimization (ReNO) method to penalize and reduce these biased outputs.

Evaluating the frequency of generating inappropriate concepts (including hate, harassment, violence, and shocking imagery) using the Inappropriate Image Prompts (I2P) benchmark, and testing a negative reward model utilizing Latent-CLIP similarity to steer the diffusion process away from these harmful representations.
